title: JSFL: document.duplicate() not implemented
description:
Flash 8 JSFL exposes a document.duplicate() method on the document object that creates and returns a copy of the current document as a new, unsaved document. This method is missing from the JsflDocument interface in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts and has no implementation.

Real Flash 8 JSFL behavior: doc.duplicate() opens a copy of the document as a new untitled document, returns a reference to the new JsflDocument. The original document is unchanged.

Impact: JSFL scripts that use document.duplicate() to create a working copy before batch-processing or destructive edits will get a TypeError ('duplicate is not a function') at runtime.

Fix: Add duplicate(): JsflDocument to the JsflDocument interface, and implement it in the makeDocProxy factory (around line 2873 in runtime.ts). The implementation should deep-clone the current FlashDocument model, push it as a new document into the runtime state, and return a JsflDocument proxy for the new document. Reuse the existing coreDuplicateScene / model deep-clone infrastructure.
